# Dion Group

> Dion Group is a venture foundry and software studio that builds operational SaaS products and custom software for companies. Based in Greece, working internationally (English, German, Greek).

Dion Group builds and operates its own SaaS products, and designs and builds custom software for client companies: web applications, operational platforms, dashboards, internal tools, and end-to-end digital systems, from concept to deployment. Areas of expertise: logistics and transport operations, terminal and yard management, workflow and document automation, and AI-assisted tooling. Aegis, an AI product, is currently in development.

## Products
- [Axon TMS](https://dion-group.com/tms/axon.html): Terminal and Transport Management System. The single operational record for a truck yard, governing gate check-in, warehouse loading, documents (CMR), and release across one record per truck, in real time. Use cases: truck management, yard management, dock and gate scheduling, fleet and logistics operations, freight document automation. Pricing from 500 euro per month per yard.

## Services
- [Custom software development](https://dion-group.com/#contact): Dion Group partners with businesses that want a custom program, app, internal system, or website built. Typical engagements: custom web apps, logistics and operations software, automation tools, and tailored SaaS.
